description: This file defines the Startup class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Setting namespace. It includes methods for managing startup configurations in the database, such as adding, deleting, retrieving, and updating the status of startup entries. The class extends a system engine model and is part of the admin module of the OpenCart project.

classes.name: Startup
classes.description: Model class for managing startup entries in the database, including create, read, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: addStartup
methods.description: Inserts a new startup record into the database with provided data, returns the ID of the inserted record.

methods.name: deleteStartup
methods.description: Deletes a startup record identified by startup_id from the database.

methods.name: deleteStartupByCode
methods.description: Deletes a startup record based on its unique code.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a startup identified by startup_id.

methods.name: getStartup
methods.description: Fetches the details of a startup by its startup_id.

methods.name: getStartupByCode
methods.description: Retrieves startup details by its unique code.

methods.name: getStartups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of startups with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalStartups
methods.description: Returns the total count of startup records in the database.
